description.en: Shows or hides a named mesh part of a map (e.g. swapping seasonal decoration meshes on and off).
Handle of the map, from CMND_GET_MAP_HANDLE.
Name of the mesh part to show/hide, e.g. "mr01b05.sakura".
1 to show the mesh, 0 to hide it.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).
